_comment: Single source of truth for your studio's in-app cross-promotion list. Replace studioName/studioURL and the sample apps below with your own. Each app vendors a copy (Swift: PortfolioRegistry.swift parses this as CrossPromoRegistry.json in the app bundle; RN: import a .ts mirror) and renders ONLY entries with a non-empty appStoreURL — so unreleased apps auto-hide and appear the moment they go live. An app excludes itself by bundleID. Apple-compliant: plain links, no incentivization, no interruptive modal. 'Made with care' is a separate single link (studioURL) shown in every app regardless of this list.
